| # bds_sec_isRequestAllowed {#bds_sec_isrequestallowed-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"} |                                                                                                                                  |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

This API function is used to check whether a specific operation is allowed for a specific security level

This API is actually under development, the result is always false!
